description: Record an estimate option as approved. Housecall Pro's own word for the result is "pro approved" - the shop writing down the customer's answer, rather than a request going out to ask for one. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Recording an answer did not email or text the customer when this was exercised. That is not a promise of silence: Housecall Pro's own automations and notification settings can send on their own, whatever any single call does, and one account's configuration says nothing about another's. Housecall Pro takes the option ids at the top of the estimates route rather than under a particular estimate, so pass option ids (est_...) and not the estimate id (csr_...). On an account configured to copy an approved option to a job, one is created and its id comes back as copied_on_approval_to_job_id; on an account that is not, that field is null and no job appears. To record the other answer use hcp_decline_estimate_options - approving is not undone by declining afterwards.

option_ids.description: One option id (est_...) or several. Option ids come from hcp_list_estimates or an estimate write response - the estimate's own id (csr_...) is not one of them.

name: hcp_approve_estimate_options
